svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Resolution and depth of focus against NA
svg.desc: Two charts against numerical aperture from 0.2 to 1.45: the half-pitch k₁λ/NA at k₁ = 0.3 and the depth of focus k₂λ/NA² at k₂ = 1 (paraxial dashed, exact solid) for KrF 248 nm, ArF 193 nm dry and in water and EUV 13.5 nm, the calculator's presets as dots; EUV at NA 0.33 gives 12.3 nm and 120 nm.
svg.text: preset with an illustrative NA (grey: other λ)
